C1: Stored cross-site scripting in C_Document::retrieve_action(): disable_exit can be set through positional URL mapping, returning raw document bytes that the public controller entry echoes as text/html.
C2: Cross-patient FHIR CareTeam access in FhirCareTeamService.php: this change removes its patient-scoped getOne override and does not implement IPatientCompartmentResourceService, so the base service does not apply patient-context filtering.
C3: Payment gateway secret exposure in portal/portal_payment.php: gateway_api_key, which can be a private Stripe API key, is rendered into client-side JavaScript for users who can reach the configured payment page.
C4: Server-side request forgery risk in eye_mag/report.php: stored report fields are emitted without escaping into HTML that a server-side PDF renderer processes; injected external resource references can cause a server-side fetch. The static review did not execute a network-fetch exploit.
F1: Missing permission checks in library/classes/Controller.class.php: checkControllerAcl() returns without a check for controllers absent from CONTROLLER_ACL_MAP, which covers only practice_settings and prescription. The new dispatch() whitelist includes sub-controllers such as pharmacy, x12_partner and patient_finder. Those were meant to be reached through the admin/practice-gated Practice Settings controller; direct dispatch lets an authenticated low-privilege user reach them. This gap also existed through the earlier positional router and was carried into the changed dispatcher.
